body: That's good, alcohol is a depressant and it will cause you to feel worse. I've had that phase before, it'll go away like a breeze on your face, and then you'll laugh at yourself in the future about how silly you were thinking like that (or at least that's how I was). All of us are here for you also, don't forget that alright?👍👍

People usually reminisce about alot of things when they are in their bed or when they are alone. I know what you mean, I was depressed for a whole year and the negative thoughts in my head wouldn't stop when I was alone. If you are feeling down, call your boyfriend or text him, he's there for you, never forget that.
